question: The Reserve Bank of India was nationalised on ________.
solution:
The Correct answer is __January 1, 1949.__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• The Reserve Bank of India was nationalised on Sat Jan 01 1949.
 
• This move was part of India's efforts to control the economy post-independence.
 
• Prior to its nationalisation, the RBI was privately owned.
 
• The nationalisation of the RBI marked a significant step in the development of India's financial sector.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

 
 

 Aspect
 Details
 
 
 
 

 **Establishment**
 The Reserve Bank of India was originally established on April 1, 1935, under the British Rule.
 
 

 **Main Functions**
 It acts as the monetary authority of India, controls the issuance and supply of the Indian rupee, and manages the country's main payment systems.
 
 

 **Monetary Policy**
 RBI uses monetary policy to create financial stability in India and is tasked with regulating the country's currency and credit systems.
 
 

 **Headquarters**
 Its headquarters are in Mumbai, Maharashtra.
 
 

 **Governance**
 The RBI is governed by a central board of directors appointed by the Government of India.
